stateOwner: the Qt controller owns one Qt-native child window, surface epoch, latest positive physical size, one in-flight command, one pending resize, cancellation admission, UI receipt state, and the shutdown barrier
threadContract: the Qt UI thread owns only QWindow embedding and immutable command publication; one persistent background presentation thread constructs, resizes, closes, and destroys PreviewPresentationSession

invariants.nativeOwnership: QML embeds one Qt-owned QWindow through WindowContainer; no external-window wrapper or manual child HWND is introduced
invariants.physicalSize: the UI thread reads the embedded HWND client rectangle and never submits zero width or height to the preview session
invariants.backgroundOwnership: session construction, resize, close, and destruction occur on the same persistent background presentation thread
invariants.boundedQueue: only one synchronous session command is in flight and resize bursts retain only the latest distinct physical size
invariants.cancellation: shutdown requests the admitted stop source before queuing serialized close and admits no later resize
invariants.surfaceEpoch: a changed HWND retires the current session instead of reusing its swap chain or accepting stale completion
invariants.shutdown: the root QML window waits for both project loading and preview session close before allowing Qt to destroy the child window; post-event-loop drain covers programmatic quit, and unexpected controller teardown retains the QWindow until background session destruction

excluded: project media resolution and playback requests
preview tick timer and interactive cadence
DPI transition and multi-display manual evidence
